exposure: High burden of physical health problems
outcome: Maternal mood (depression, anxiety, fatigue, irritability, confusion, vigor)
cohort: 229 nulliparous pregnant women ≥ 18 years of age, ≥ 36-week gestation, singleton pregnancy, and with sufficient English recruited from a public and a private maternity hospital in Melbourne, Australia
finding: A high burden of breastfeeding problems, both alone and with co-morbid physical health problems, was significantly associated with poorer maternal mood at 8 weeks postpartum.
mod_finding: Women who experienced a high burden of physical symptoms, including caesarean/perineal pain, had poorer maternal mood at 8 weeks postpartum.
